unresolvedAiThreads.body:
`RetrieveDocument` uses `_httpConnector.SendAsync<T>(...)`, which (via `VAA.EAPI.GraphQL.Infrastructure.Services.HttpConnector`) logs request/response content on non-success responses. Because the request body includes `DocumentUrl`, any downstream 4xx/5xx (including a normal 404) can write the DMAZE URL into telemetry, conflicting with the “don’t log document-url” constraint. Also, the current call path throws for non-success status codes, preventing the caller from distinguishing NotFound vs other failures.

Prefer the non-throwing `SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage, CancellationToken)` overload and handle status codes explicitly (return null for 404; throw a sanitized exception otherwise), then deserialize only on success.
unresolvedAiThreads.resolutionComment: Valid. HolidayProvider now uses the non-throwing raw HttpResponseMessage connector overload, returns null for HTTP 404, throws a sanitized HttpRequestException containing only a controlled message and status for other failures, and deserializes the response body only after a successful status. This prevents the request body containing DocumentUrl from being added to connector exception telemetry. The GraphQL Trips project builds with 0 warnings/errors, and the focused HolidayProvider/holiday document contract test run passed with TRX analysis (coverage: 9.22% line, 6.99% branch).

unresolvedAiThreads.body:
`RetrieveDocument` downloads the DMAZE file via `_httpConnector.SendAsync(documentUri.ToString(), ...)` (line 237). The shared `VAA.EAPI.Infrastructure.Services.HttpConnector` logs `request.RequestUri` at info level for every request (`HttpConnector.cs:139`), which will include the full DMAZE `documentUri` (and therefore the otherwise-hidden downstream URL) in telemetry.

Given the sequence-goal constraint “do not log the document-url”, this call path should be adjusted so the connector does not emit the full URL (e.g., add a redaction option / log-safe URI to the connector, or introduce a dedicated download client/logger for this flow).
unresolvedAiThreads.resolutionComment: Valid. Added an explicit HttpRequestMessage option for sensitive requests to suppress full request-URI logging. RetrieveDocument marks only the DMAZE download request with that option, and the shared connector logs the URI authority (scheme/host/port) instead of the sensitive path/query while retaining method, response content length, and timing telemetry. Other connector calls retain existing URI logging. The Retail Holidays project builds with 0 warnings/errors, and all 82 Holidays tests passed with TRX analysis. Coverage was unavailable because this project's Microsoft Testing Platform runner does not expose the configured coverage option.
